text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Japan Cup.
Jungle Pocket had once said something like this.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Even so, complaining won't change anything. The Satsuki Sho isn't gonna turn into a counterclockwise track just for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, this time...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tch, damn it all...
It really could've happened, couldn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: To think the venue would change from Tokyo Racecourse, my forte, to Nakayama Racecourse.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it couldn't be helped this time...
Yeah, it couldn't be helped this time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason is—renovations at the racetrack.
With a clockwise track at 2,200 meters,
we can hardly say we have home advantage, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Well, can't be helped. We're aiming for consecutive wins.
The starting gun won't wait for us."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna beat 'em all down!
Including all those new Umamusume!
choice_data_list: So, Pokke... how's your leg feeling?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "My legs? Who knows..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You never know unless you try.
If I'm gonna go down, I'll go down after I win.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, for this year's 'Japan Cup.'
First to emerge is
last year's champion, Jungle Pocket!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And standing in her way are the familiar powerhouses.
Narita Top Road!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Pokke-chan!
I lost last year, but this year will be different!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, good to see you, Top Road.
Your staying power never ceases to amaze me.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And Air Shakur,
relying on data and running purely on logic!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Pokke, you were out of luck.
This year's conditions just weren't in your favor...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Data Nerd.
Something like this just takes a little guts.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Next, the rising stars from
the Classic class make their entrance!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha-ha!
I am the Umamusume who shall become the general of a new era—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I am No Reason!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho?! Coming at me, Lord Pokke?
If so, I shall make you rust upon my horseshoes!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, a noisy one has appeared.
...Oh well, whatever.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's gonna make you rust on my brass knuckles.
However—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Today's problem isn't this one.
—It's the other one."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Jungle Pocket...
The king of beasts."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I will hunt you.
That is――my final Mission for this year."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Heh, if you think you can do it, give it your best shot, Kris S."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate me.
My running is... a bit rough, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The venue erupts in excitement for the monumental clash
mixing Senior and Classic Class racers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Literally the first battle to decide the strongest of the next generation.
Ideally, we'd want to show an overwhelming gap in ability, but—

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's see what you've got.
Pocket's current strength, and...

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
Tell me the state of my legs.
Everything else can wait until after that, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I contacted the instructor in Hokkaido, the other owner of "L/Roars",
and invited them to the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We have to work together somehow to rescue Jungle Pocket from this desperate dead end.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(If I mess up, this could be the end...
Like hell I'll accept that, though!
I haven't run nearly enough yet!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (The Classic year newcomers, huh. We've got quite a few fierce competitors gathered here.)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Kris S, No Reason.
I'll teach you just how terrifying a wounded beast can be.
